Final Fantasy VII Rebirth — PS5 Buying Guide

PlayStation 5 · Updated 2026-08-05

Final Fantasy VII Rebirth is the middle chapter of Square Enix's FFVII remake trilogy — a massive open-world RPG that expands the story well beyond the original game's Midgar section.

What to know before buying

  • Play Remake first — Rebirth assumes you've played Intergrade; it's not a standalone starting point
  • Standard vs Deluxe — Deluxe adds a art book and soundtrack app; no story content
  • New release timing — first real discounts land a few months after launch

Where to buy cheapest

As a newer release, Rebirth holds list price at first. Key stores like Green Man Gaming undercut the PlayStation Store once the first sale window opens — worth watching if you're not in a rush.

  • Check Green Man Gaming
  • Check on Amazon
